column3: “Her” replaces the repeated land of Israel.
“Not to return it” replaces the sword not returning.
“A broken heart” replaces breaking of loins.
The question extends to the scepter of My son; “such stick” renders every tree.
“Will come” supplies the timing of testing.
“Great slaughter” renders the great slain one.
“Where the road branches off to each city” expands the beginning of the road to a city.
“Fork” renders mother of the road; “idols” renders teraphim.
“Final punishment” renders the iniquity of the end.
“Things will not remain as they are” expands this is not this.
“Be restored” is supplied; “assigned the right of judgment” replaces the closing I will give it.
“Final punishment” renders the iniquity of the end.
